hook: One board for Classes *IX to XII*: Inter board to be scrapped
hook_b: One board for Classes *IX to XII*: Inter board to be scrapped
tldr: With the government deciding to scrap the intermediate system, a common Telangana School Education Board is likely to run academics and exams for Classes IX to XII.

beats.what: The government will amend the Telangana Education Act 1962 and repeal the Intermediate Education Act 1971 through a Bill.
beats.why: Today, Class X exams are run by the Directorate of Government Examinations and Inter exams by the Telangana Board of Intermediate Education.
beats.care: Officials say no decision has been taken on scrapping Class XI board exams, and the integration will be done slowly.

causes.label: Govt decides to scrap Inter system

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Bill is expected in the coming winter Assembly session.

cards.q: Should Class XI board exams continue under a common board?

qs: What happens to students already in Inter first year when the board changes?
Will junior college lecturers teach Classes IX and X?

facts.t: Intermediate education has been run under a separate law since *1971*.

viz.verdict: Changes who runs exams for students in Classes IX to XII

steps.e: Education Act 1962 amended, Inter Act 1971 repealed

viz.verdict: Details still being worked out, officials say

watch: Whether the Bill is tabled in the winter Assembly session, and what it says on Class XI exams.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana plans common school education board for Classes IX to XII

fact: Telangana plans one school board for Classes *IX to XII*, ending the Inter board
twist: Junior colleges may add Classes IX and X, while schools with space may add XI and XII.
